title: Frame Output Transformers Used With Television Picture Tubes, Part 2: Type fot IH for 470, 510, S90 and 610 mm Television Picture Tubes
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10488 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Frame Output Transformers Used With Television Picture Tubes, Part 2: Type fot IH for 470, 510, S90 and 610 mm Television Picture Tubes.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
Frame Output Transformers Used with Television Picture Tubes, Part 1: General Requirements and Tests

clause_3_terminology: Frame Output Transformers Used With Television Picture Tubes
S90 and 610 mm Television Picture Tubes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
